mathematical_review.radius: Finite sup' covers all pairs of basis indices, with a nonempty carrier even at width0. Each halfwidth is <=maxRadius. mathematical_review.operator_norm: Matrix.toEuclideanCLM is the actual induced endomorphism of real EuclideanSpace, not an entrywise Matrix norm. For each row, Cauchy-Schwarz gives (Ax)_i^2 <= sum_j A_ij^2 * norm(x)^2 <= size*r^2*norm(x)^2. Summing size rows yields norm(Ax)^2<=size^2*r^2*norm(x)^2. Nonnegative norm/r justifies taking squares back to opnorm<=size*r, size=2^width.
